description: TOML scalar coercion vectors. Each entry pairs a raw TOML literal (as it appears after the '=' sign) with the expected Lua and AHK coerced values. Used by the macOS and AHK corpus consumer tests to pin the 4 hand-rolled coercion sites against each other.
note: Lua M.coerce uses SEQUENTIAL gsubs (\\->\ first, then \n->newline), which is buggy but matches production behavior. AHK UnescapeTomlString uses single-pass (correct). The 'lua' and 'ahk' expected values may differ where the sequential approach produces a different result.

field_semantics.notes: DESCRIPTIVE, not an input. A short human label for the coercion each vector covers ("Boolean true", "Integer"). No replay reads it; the behaviour is carried by input/lua/ahk. Recorded here so it is not mistaken for something that steers the vector.

vectors.notes: Lua sequential gsubs: \\→\ then \n→newline. AHK single-pass: \\→\ then n→n.
Lua sequential gsubs: \\→\ then \t→tab. AHK single-pass: \\→\ then t→t.
Lua sequential gsubs: \\→\ creates new \t from \to, then \t→tab. Result: path<TAB>o\file. AHK single-pass: \\→\ then t→t. Result: path\to\file.
